fallbackIfWindBlocked.compatibility: Same jurisdiction/instrument/year, implemented carbon price in explicit original currency/price basis, denominator-specific covered-emissions fraction and exemption/free-allocation limitations; no net-zero target coverage or corporate commitments substitution

fallbackIfWindBlocked.fullWindowFitRule: A frozen cost-study window cannot be repurposed for policy. If no already frozen compatible policy predictive protocol/outcome exists, do not fit or score; report the dependency-ready accounting measure only with source/status limitations.

classification: Any assembled non-estimated policy exposure is descriptive empirical accounting, not a calibrated causal elasticity. Unidentified elasticity is unavailable, not an invented prior. Existing sensitivity-only distributions stay sensitivity-only.

policyOperationalFreezeBeforeProduct.source: World Bank State and Trends of Carbon Pricing2025, original repository publication id e5f6e755-e6a6-4d2c-927a-23b5cc8a9b03; issued2025-06-10
policyOperationalFreezeBeforeProduct.selection: Complete single global2025 snapshot, not selectively chosen jurisdictions or a price ranking
policyOperationalFreezeBeforeProduct.inputs: Publisher's rounded global implemented-instrument covered-emissions-weighted mean price, and publisher's rounded fraction of global GHG covered. Both refer to policy situation2025-04-01; source coverage uses latest2023 GHG inventories. Keep these dates distinct.
policyOperationalFreezeBeforeProduct.formula: gross descriptive policy exposure = reported mean price per covered tCO2e * reported covered fraction of total GHG
policyOperationalFreezeBeforeProduct.priceBasis: Real2025 USD/tCO2e, publisher's CPI conversion; do not reuse revenue values in real2024 USD, mix exchange-rate bases, or multiply the already-global-weighted price by coverage again
policyOperationalFreezeBeforeProduct.crossCheck: Record publisher's independently stated rounded global-weighted price as contextual consistency only; no fitted accuracy or acceptance test
policyOperationalFreezeBeforeProduct.exemptionsAndFreeAllocation: Both explicitly unknown/not fully adjusted in source scope estimate; no zero substitution, no assumption that free allocation erases marginal allowance incentive, no estimate of net effective tax/enforcement/behaviour
policyOperationalFreezeBeforeProduct.uncertainty: Unknown rounding/source/process uncertainty; no invented probability distribution, standard error, interval or literature elasticity
policyOperationalFreezeBeforeProduct.status: Sensitivity-only descriptive accounting snapshot, not calibrated prior/central coefficient, and not a predictive study
policyOperationalFreezeBeforeProduct.centralNegativeControl: Any central request for this context snapshot must reject

privateValidation: Real original source assertions remain explicitly invoked outside public test globs; missing sources fail. Public tests use synthetic engineering fixtures only.
prohibited: Paid calls, credentials, billing/approval/scheduler changes, commits, deploys, shared semantics/routes/ledgers edits, old-study reruns or false full-window acceptance
